'''Valentina''' is an NPC in [[Tethys Hub]], [[The Black Shores]]. She is a Bloom Bearer and the remote commander of the organization's emergency response team, a combat unit sent by the Black Shores to deal with the Waveworn phenomenon.

==Quests and Events==

{{Quests and Events|Valentina}}
*[[Infinite Battle Simulation (Quest)]] (October 24, 2024-November 13, 2024)
<!--*[[Tidal Defense Simulator]] (August 30, 2025-October 08, 2025) seems it's working again-->

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Day)
:'''Valentina:''' You have 48 hours to assist the locals and evacuate everyone to the designated safe zones before the Lament strikes.
:'''Valentina:''' The disaster relief will last for one week. After that, I'll issue new orders based on the situation.
:'''Valentina:''' Report any unexpected events immediately. No unauthorized actions or disobedience will be tolerated within the emergency response team.
:'''Emergency Response Team Member:''' Yes, Madam.
:{{DIcon}} What's an emergency response team?
:'''Valentina:''' It seems you're not familiar with our team. While I wait for my next communication, let me give you a quick briefing.
:'''Valentina:''' I'm Valentina, the remote commander of the emergency response team. This is a combat unit sent by the Black Shores to deal with the Waveworn phenomenon.
:'''Valentina:''' Every member here has been rigorously trained and selected.
:'''Valentina:''' They're the backbone of the Black Shores, each with extensive experience in handling TDs and rescues.
:'''Valentina:''' Final preparations are underway. This team will deploy shortly.
:'''Emergency Response Team Member:''' Don't you worry about us, Commander! You know we've got this. We'll be back with a victory, no question about it.
:'''Valentina:''' ...This is not the time for jokes. Stay focused.
----
;(Night)
:''Valentina is communicating with the dispatched members of the emergency response team.
:'''Valentina:''' The TD Outbreak will hit your position in 30 minutes. There's almost no time left for a rescue operation.
:'''Valentina:''' ...
:'''Valentina:''' Yes, your assessment is accurate.
:'''Valentina:''' You've never been wrong, Yuri. That's why I've always trusted your judgment.
:'''Valentina:''' I've never regretted the decisions I've made, and I hope this one won't be an exception.
{{Dialogue End}}
